query: William Pery served as Captain of the Yeomen of the Guard under the lord who served in what position from 1865 to 1868?

pipeline_result.response: Based on the information provided, William Pery served as a Captain of the Yeomanry of the Guard during the time period from 1865 to 1868. He was appointed as a Captain in 1864 and remained in command until his retirement in 1868.
